infrastructure_project_type.label: Infrastructure project type
infrastructure_project_type.value: Highway and local road construction and resurfacing, airport runway rehabilitation, bridge work, and commercial, industrial, and residential site preparation.

public_private_client_mix.label: Public / private client mix
public_private_client_mix.value: Public transportation and other infrastructure projects for government agencies, municipalities, school districts, and military installations, plus private work for developers and commercial property owners.

contracted_backlog.label: Contracted backlog
contracted_backlog.value: Expected revenue from remaining work on awarded construction projects.

heavy_equipment_model.label: Heavy-equipment model
heavy_equipment_model.value: Company investment in equipment for local crews that pave, mill, and maintain roads, runways, and sites.

fixed_price_cost_overrun_exposure.label: Fixed-price / cost-overrun exposure
fixed_price_cost_overrun_exposure.value: Primarily fixed unit-price contracts, with some lump-sum work and margin exposure when actual costs exceed bid estimates.

notes: Typical project delivery duration is uncertain.
